text: ぶらさがったまま　エサとなる　ムシが　とんでくるのを　まっている。

structure.jp: エサとなる　ムシが　とんでくるのを
structure.en: for bugs that will be its food to come flying

patterns.name: 〜たまま
patterns.explanation: まま after a past verb means staying in that state, unchanged. ぶらさがったまま = 'still hanging there'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing, so it can be what is waited for. とんでくるのを = 'for them to come flying'.

patterns.name: 〜となる
patterns.explanation: となる means 'to become' or 'to serve as', a bookish に なる. エサとなる　ムシ = 'bugs that become its food'.
